title: IE8 not even supported with polyfill
body:
Taking your example https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/examples/media/ it is likely a small strict error or something.

As to why IE8: since Bootstrap 3 still supports it and many e-commerce sites still have to support IE8 currently.

comments.body: Hi @Sammaye unfortunately we do not officially support IE8 and won't spend time on it. This browser version is deprecated. https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/WindowsForBusiness/End-of-IE-support

I realise it is not officially supported but the polyfill fully supports IE8 and technically it should just be standards error using the polyfill, not a full on functionality error, so was kind of hoping maybe a quick look into it would be allowed, but ok

Unfortunately I don't even have anymore any VirtualBox capable of running IE8, those went out of service at some point and I never managed to get them back up.

Most of my debugging sessions with old IES are taking a LOT of time with little return on investement for IE8.

You can have a try if you want with https://developer.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/tools/vms/.

Thanks for your understanding.
I have the VMs but unfortauntely I just don't know enough about react, in a way this is the problem with modern web development; so many tools no one can possibly know them all

@Sammaye for this kind of issue there's little chance it's linked to React completely. As a first try you could use the IE8 debugger to see what is the failing JavaScript call. That would help already.

Are you using instantsearch lite?

I am mostly using the default one here //
cdn.jsdelivr.net/instantsearch.js/1/instantsearch.min.js
